text:
Another gray, damp start to the week. We're in the mid 40s this morning with light showers around, and the best chance of rain is through the first half of the day, wrapping up by early afternoon. A stray shower could linger into the evening. Totals stay under a tenth of an inch, but a stronger shower could bring a quick downpour or some graupel this afternoon. The forecast models disagree on how wet today gets, so keep the umbrella handy. The high is near 51, and tonight drops to around 40.

Tuesday starts mostly dry, then showers return around noon and peak between 1 and 6, again under a tenth of an inch, with a high near 51. Tuesday night turns colder, with a low near 37 and a little more rain, a tenth to a quarter inch. Wednesday looks like the driest day, still cloudy and cool, in the upper 40s, then low 40s Thursday.

Watch Friday into Saturday. A system could bring rain and some wintry mix, but the track is very uncertain. For a walk Tuesday, go before noon.

week.blurb: Cloudy with a few showers possible until late afternoon, high near 51; the models lean wetter, so grab the umbrella.
Dry start Tuesday, then showers likely from late morning on, high near 51, with a bit more rain after dark.
Veterans Day is cloudy and cooler, high near 48, with a stray early shower, then flakes possible after 1am.
Mostly cloudy and quiet Thursday, high near 47, with just a slight chance of a flake early or a shower later.
Trending raw and cloudy Friday, high near 44, with snow possible early and a rain-snow mix off and on after.
Looks like another chilly, cloudy day near 44, with early flakes turning to scattered rain, though odds stay around 40 percent.
Sunday looks cloudy and a hair milder near 45, with early flakes possible and a few leftover rain or snow showers.
